summary: Iteration 6 (DB Config) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass covering services CRUD (create + 409 duplicate, list-with-instance_count, rename, admin-only delete, delete blocked-by-instances 409), instances CRUD (invalid service_id 400, aws_instance_id 409 dup, invalid environment 422, metadata dedup by attribute_key, service_id filter with joined service_name, search, update, member 403 on delete), Excel import (rejects non-.xlsx 400; xlsx with extra owner/team columns auto-creates services, promotes extras to metadata, and skips duplicate aws_instance_id rows returning {imported, skipped}), and JSON export (returns {db_services, db_instances, db_instance_metadata} with integer ids and FK integrity). Frontend /db-config admin flows verified: nav-db-config loads page, sidebar service creation (db-new-service+db-add-service), instance dialog (service+env+status Selects + metadata rows), edit persists, search filters, Export JSON downloads db_config.json, Upload Excel dialog imports xlsx, delete instance via db-delete-*/db-confirm-delete works. Member permission confirmed: db-delete-<id> and db-delete-service-<id> both hidden (count=0) and backend rejects with 403. Cleanup completed - no residual test data left.

issues: DialogContent radix-ui warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' - a11y warning only, non-blocking

Opening radix Select triggers benign ResizeObserver loop warnings that surface via CRA webpack-dev-server-client-overlay and intercept pointer events during tests. Production build not affected, but noisy in preview. Consider adding a small window.addEventListener('error') suppressor for ResizeObserver messages or upgrading react-scripts.

critical_code_review_comments: db_config.py list_instances: async dict-comprehension over db_services is fine but for large service catalogs consider caching; currently OK.
db_config.py export-json: meta_seq is a running counter global across instances which matches SQL AUTO_INCREMENT semantics — correct.
db_config.py delete_service returns 409 with instance count — good; message clear.
DbInstanceForm.jsx: Metadata attribute_key uniqueness is only enforced server-side (_dedup_meta). Consider client-side warning to avoid silent drops when a user enters duplicate keys.
DbInstanceForm.jsx & ExcelUpload.jsx dialogs are missing DialogDescription -> radix a11y warning (minor).
